cards.text: Israel is camped at the foot of Mount Sinai, and the mountain is wrapped in smoke and quaking. Moses, Israel's leader, has gone down to the people. And then God speaks all these words.

cards.question: Before a single command, God tells Israel who He is. He's the LORD their God who did what?
Then comes the first command. Since He's the LORD their God, what does He tell Israel?

answers.text: Have no other gods before Him
Build Him an altar on the mountain
Bring Him an offering each morning

cards.question: God tells Israel not to make an ___ in the form of anything in the heavens, on the earth or in the waters.

cards.text: And it's not just about making them, because God says don't bow down to them or worship them either.

cards.question: God gives a reason Israel must not bow down to idols. What kind of God does He call Himself?

cards.text: Then God sets two things side by side. For those who hate Him, the iniquity of the fathers is visited on their children to the third and fourth generations.

cards.question: For those who love God and keep His commandments, He shows loving devotion to a thousand generations.
God says He will leave unpunished anyone who takes His name in vain.

cards.text: Next, God puts a day on the calendar: "Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy." Friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, trust me, being REMEMBERED is a big deal.

cards.question: Six days are for labor. Then the ___ day is a Sabbath to the LORD, with no ___ at all.
The Sabbath rest God commands even covers Israel's livestock.

cards.text: And it's not only the boss who rests. Sons, daughters, servants and even the foreigner within your gates get the day off, so NOBODY in that house gets the "hey, can you cover a shift?" call.

cards.question: God gives Israel a reason for the Sabbath. What is it?

answers.text: He made everything in six days and rested on the seventh
Israel rested for seven days after leaving Egypt
Moses waited seven days at the foot of the mountain

cards.text: That's why the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy. He set the pattern Himself, way back at creation.
The next command starts at home. God says to honor your father and mother, and this one comes with a promise.

cards.question: What does God promise to those who honor their father and mother?

answers.text: Long days in the land God is giving them
A double share of their father's land
Many sons to carry on their name

cards.text: Then the commands get REAL short, no speeches, just BAM: "You shall not murder." BAM: "You shall not commit adultery."

cards.question: Another short command, and this one protects what belongs to someone else: You shall not ___.
Next, God gives Israel a command about their neighbor. What is it?

answers.text: Do not bear false witness against him
Do not lend to him for profit
Do not move his boundary stone

cards.text: One more: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house." And God keeps going with his wife, his servants, his ox and his donkey.

cards.question: After the house, the wife, the servants, the ox and the donkey, how does God finish the list of things not to covet?

answers.text: Anything that belongs to your neighbor
The tents of the nations around you
The riches you left behind in Egypt

cards.text: Now look at the scene the people are standing in: thunder, lightning, the ram's horn sounding and the mountain wrapped in smoke.

cards.question: Seeing the thunder, the lightning and the smoke, the people rush closer to the mountain.
The people go to Moses with a request. What do they ask?

answers.text: That Moses speak to them instead of God
That Moses take them back to Egypt
That Moses lead them away from Sinai

cards.text: Their words: "But do not let God speak to us, or we will die." I get it, friend, because back in the drawer we all held our breath every time the light came in, and that was just a KITCHEN light.

cards.question: Moses tells the people not to be afraid.
Moses says God has come to test the people, so the fear of Him will keep them from ___.
While the people stand at a distance, Moses stays back with them.

cards.text: The people stay back, and Moses approaches the thick darkness where God was. Hold on to your apron, friend, because what happens up in that darkness is a story for next time.

findings.problem: The citation is wider than the verses of the right answer. Both correct completions, "seventh" and "work" in the Sabbath command, come from Exodus 20:10. Exodus 20:9 only supplies the setup about six days of labor, so the choice card should cite Exodus 20:10 rather than Exodus 20:9-10.

rule.text: A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.
